title: SENIOR SCENE | Betsy Broyles Arnold to keynote The Caring Place Ladies Luncheon
text:
The Caring Place is pleased to welcome Betsy Broyles Arnold as the keynote speaker for our 4th Annual Ladies Luncheon on Oct. 27, 2026. Betsy is CEO of the Broyles Foundation and has been named the Arkansas Broadcasters Association's 2026 Arkansan of the Year.
Betsy has a very personal connection to the challenges faced by families caring for a loved one with Alzheimer's disease or another form of dementia. She and her father, legendary Razorback Coach Frank Broyles, created the Playbook for Alzheimer's Caregivers to provide practical guidance and encouragement to families navigating the caregiving journey. We are honored to have her join us and share her experience with our community.
For more than 30 years, The Caring Place has provided respite, support and hope to local families caring for loved ones with dementia. Our adult day respite program gives caregivers much-needed time to work, attend appointments, run errands or simply rest, knowing their loved one is in a safe, caring and engaging environment.
Located at 101 Quapaw Ave. in Hot Springs, The Caring Place offers a structured day filled with exercise, music, games, creative activities, daily devotionals, home-cooked meals and opportunities to enjoy our beautiful outdoor spaces. Just as importantly, our participants enjoy friendship, laughter and a sense of belonging.
Volunteers are an important part of what makes The Caring Place special. Whether you can give a few hours each week or help occasionally, we would love to have you join us. Our volunteers often tell us they receive just as much from their time here as they give.
The Caring Place is open Monday through Thursday, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. To learn more about our program, volunteering or the Ladies Luncheon, visit our website, find The Caring Place Hot Springs on Facebook, or call 501-623-2881.
